```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Species-level Enterococcus dPCR — merge with metadata
# Process technical replicates per Target (cecorum vs hirae)
# ==============================================================

library(dplyr)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Add metadata and filter to biological samples (1-60)
# ==============================================================

entero_species_filtered <- entero.species.dpcr %>%
  dplyr::filter(Sample.NTC.Control %in% as.character(1:60)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(sample_key = paste0("Sample_", Sample.NTC.Control)) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta, by = c("sample_key" = "Sample.ID")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sample_key)

cat("Species-level filtered samples:", nrow(entero_species_filtered), "\n")

# ==============================================================
# 2. Collapse technical duplicates per Sample × Target
# ==============================================================

entero_species_summary <- entero_species_filtered %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Conc.dpcr      = as.numeric(`Conc...cp.µL...dPCR.reaction.`),
    Conc.undiluted = as.numeric(`Conc...cp.µL...undiluted.sample.`)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Sample.NTC.Control, Target..Name.) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Conc.dpcr.mean      = mean(Conc.dpcr,      na.rm = TRUE),
    Conc.undiluted.mean = mean(Conc.undiluted, na.rm = TRUE),
    Growout             = first(Growout),
    Position            = first(Position),
    Treatment           = first(Treatment),
    House               = first(House),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Species summary rows (Sample × Target combinations):", 
    nrow(entero_species_summary), "\n")

# Check Target distribution
cat("\nTarget species distribution:\n")
print(table(entero_species_summary$Target..Name.))

# Check samples per target
cat("\nSamples per target:\n")
entero_species_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target..Name.) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_samples = dplyr::n_distinct(Sample.NTC.Control),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

print(head(entero_species_summary))

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Add Qubit concentrations and calculate copies per gram litter
# Species-level Enterococcus dPCR
# ==============================================================

# ==============================================================
# 1. Merge with Qubit data
# ==============================================================

entero_species_merged <- entero_species_summary %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(Sample.NTC.Control)) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    entero.qubit.clean %>%
      dplyr::select(Sample, X260.230, X260.280, ng.uL..nanodrop., ng.uL..qubit.),
    by = c("Sample.NTC.Control" = "Sample")
  )

cat("Species-level samples after Qubit merge:", nrow(entero_species_merged), "\n")

# ==============================================================
# 2. Back-calculate to copies per gram litter
# ==============================================================

elution_vol <- 100

entero_species_merged <- entero_species_merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    copies_per_reaction = Conc.dpcr.mean * 15,
    copies_per_ng       = copies_per_reaction / 10,  # Corrected from /4 to /10
    total_ng_extracted  = ng.uL..qubit. * elution_vol,
    copies_per_g_litter = copies_per_ng * total_ng_extracted / 0.25
  )

cat("Species-level calculation complete.\n")
cat("Samples per target after calculations:\n")
entero_species_merged %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target..Name.) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

print(head(entero_species_merged %>%
             dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Target..Name., 
                           Conc.dpcr.mean, ng.uL..qubit.,
                           copies_per_reaction, copies_per_ng,
                           total_ng_extracted, copies_per_g_litter)))

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
```
```{r}
# Distribution screening for species-level copies_per_g_litter
# Separate analysis for each Target species (cecorum vs hirae)
# ==============================================================

library(MASS)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Add log10 transformation
entero_species_merged <- entero_species_merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    log10_copies_per_g_litter = log10(copies_per_g_litter)
  )

target_species <- unique(entero_species_merged$Target..Name.)
growouts <- c("1", "2")
vars <- c("copies_per_g_litter", "log10_copies_per_g_litter")

for (target in target_species) {
  
  cat("\n==============================================\n")
  cat("TARGET SPECIES:", target, "\n")
  cat("==============================================\n")
  
  for (g in growouts) {
    
    df_sub <- entero_species_merged %>%
      dplyr::filter(Growout == g, Target..Name. == target)
    
    cat("\n============================\n")
    cat(paste("Target:", target, "| Growout:", g, "\n"))
    
    for (v in vars) {
      
      y <- df_sub[[v]]
      y <- y[!is.na(y) & is.finite(y)]
      
      if (length(y) < 3) {
        cat(paste("Skipping", v, "- too few samples\n"))
        next
      }
      
      cat("\n----------------------------\n")
      cat(paste("Variable:", v, "\n"))
      
      shapiro_result <- shapiro.test(y)
      cat("Shapiro-Wilk p-value:", round(shapiro_result$p.value, 4), "\n")
      
      # Plot histogram
      p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = .data[[v]])) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 15, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
        ggtitle(paste(target, "-", v, "- Growout", g)) +
        theme_bw()
      print(p)
      
      # Distribution fitting
      dist_fits <- list()
      try(dist_fits$normal  <- MASS::fitdistr(y, "normal"), silent = TRUE)
      try(dist_fits$gamma   <- MASS::fitdistr(y[y > 0], "gamma"), silent = TRUE)
      try(dist_fits$lognorm <- MASS::fitdistr(y[y > 0], "lognormal"), silent = TRUE)
      
      if (length(dist_fits) > 0) {
        aics <- sapply(dist_fits, AIC)
        cat("AICs:\n")
        print(round(aics, 2))
        cat("Best distribution (AIC):", names(which.min(aics)), "\n")
      } else {
        cat("No successful distribution fits\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Species-level Enterococcus GLMM — Raw counts with appropriate distribution
# Updated to preserve zeros and use raw copy numbers
# ==============================================================

library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(dplyr)

# ==============================================================
# Helper functions
# ==============================================================

.extract_rand_var <- function(model) {
  vc <- try(VarCorr(model), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vc, "try-error")) return(NA_real_)
  vcdf <- try(as.data.frame(vc), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vcdf, "try-error") || !nrow(vcdf)) return(NA_real_)
  row <- vcdf[vcdf$component == "cond" & grepl("Growout:House", vcdf$grp), , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(row)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(row$sdcor[1])^2  # SD^2 -> variance
}

.fit_one_species_raw <- function(target_species, var_thresh = 1e-6, n_sims = 1000) {
  
  # Prepare data - keep all samples including zeros
  df <- entero_species_merged %>%
    dplyr::filter(Target..Name. == target_species) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Growout   = as.factor(Growout),
      Treatment = as.factor(Treatment),
      House     = as.factor(House),
      Position  = as.factor(Position),
      copies_raw = copies_per_g_litter
    )
  
  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Species:", target_species, "| n =", nrow(df), "\n")
  cat("Zeros:", sum(df$copies_raw == 0), "| Non-zeros:", sum(df$copies_raw > 0), "\n")
  
  # Set contrasts for Type III
  .old_contr <- options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
  
  # Try Tweedie family first (handles zeros naturally)
  model_full <- tryCatch({
    glmmTMB(
      copies_raw ~ Treatment * Growout + Position + (1 | Growout:House),
      family = tweedie(link = "log"),
      data = df
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Tweedie failed, trying gamma with small constant\n")
    # Fallback: Add small constant for gamma family
    df$copies_adj <- df$copies_raw + 0.1
    glmmTMB(
      copies_adj ~ Treatment * Growout + Position + (1 | Growout:House),
      family = Gamma(link = "log"),
      data = df
    )
  })
  
  # Check if we used adjusted values
  used_adjustment <- "copies_adj" %in% names(df) && 
                     "copies_adj" %in% all.vars(formula(model_full))
  
  if (used_adjustment) {
    cat("Used gamma family with +0.1 adjustment\n")
  } else {
    cat("Used Tweedie family (natural zero handling)\n")
  }
  
  # Check random effect variance
  kept_random <- TRUE
  rv <- .extract_rand_var(model_full)
  if (!is.na(rv) && rv <= var_thresh) {
    kept_random <- FALSE
    cat("Random effect dropped (variance ≤", var_thresh, ")\n")
    
    # Refit without random effect
    if (used_adjustment) {
      model_full <- glmmTMB(
        copies_adj ~ Treatment * Growout + Position,
        family = Gamma(link = "log"),
        data = df
      )
    } else {
      model_full <- glmmTMB(
        copies_raw ~ Treatment * Growout + Position,
        family = tweedie(link = "log"),
        data = df
      )
    }
  } else {
    cat("Random effect retained\n")
  }
  
  # Type III Wald tests
  anova_result <- car::Anova(model_full, type = 3)
  print(anova_result)
  
  # Global treatment effect (marginal means)
  cat("\n--- Global Treatment Effect ---\n")
  global_emm <- emmeans(model_full, ~ Treatment)
  global_pairs <- contrast(global_emm, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
  global_df <- as.data.frame(summary(global_pairs))
  global_df$Species <- target_species
  global_df$Comparison <- "Global"
  global_df$Growout <- NA
  print(summary(global_pairs))
  
  # Per-growout treatment effects
  cat("\n--- Per-Growout Treatment Effects ---\n")
  pergrowout_emm <- emmeans(model_full, ~ Treatment | Growout)
  pergrowout_pairs <- contrast(pergrowout_emm, method = "pairwise", adjust = "BH")
  pergrowout_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pergrowout_pairs))
  pergrowout_df$Species <- target_species
  pergrowout_df$Comparison <- paste("Growout", pergrowout_df$Growout)
  print(summary(pergrowout_pairs))
  
  # DHARMa diagnostics
  cat("\n--- DHARMa Diagnostics ---\n")
  simres <- simulateResiduals(model_full, n = n_sims)
  disp_test <- testDispersion(simres)
  out_test <- testOutliers(simres)
  quant_test <- testQuantiles(simres)
  
  cat("Dispersion p =", round(disp_test$p.value, 4), "\n")
  cat("Outliers p =", round(out_test$p.value, 4), "\n")
  cat("Quantiles p =", round(quant_test$p.value, 4), "\n")
  
  # Restore contrasts
  options(.old_contr)
  
  # Combine results
  common_cols <- intersect(names(global_df), names(pergrowout_df))
  all_pairs_df <- rbind(
    global_df[, common_cols],
    pergrowout_df[, common_cols]
  )
  
  return(list(
    species = target_species,
    kept_random = kept_random,
    used_adjustment = used_adjustment,
    model = model_full,
    anova = anova_result,
    global_emmeans = global_emm,
    pergrowout_emmeans = pergrowout_emm,
    global_pairs = global_pairs,
    pergrowout_pairs = pergrowout_pairs,
    all_pairs_df = all_pairs_df,
    dharma = list(sim = simres, dispersion = disp_test, 
                  outliers = out_test, quantiles = quant_test)
  ))
}

# ==============================================================
# Fit models for both species using raw counts
# ==============================================================

target_species <- c("Cecorum", "Hirae")

species_models_raw <- lapply(target_species, .fit_one_species_raw)
names(species_models_raw) <- target_species

# ==============================================================
# Collect results
# ==============================================================

species_pairs_raw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(species_models_raw, `[[`, "all_pairs_df"))
rownames(species_pairs_raw) <- NULL

species_anova_raw <- lapply(species_models_raw, function(x) {
  out <- as.data.frame(x$anova)
  out$Term <- rownames(out)
  out$Species <- x$species
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out[, c("Species", "Term", setdiff(names(out), c("Species", "Term")))]
})

# ==============================================================
# Summary
# ==============================================================

cat("\n==============================================\n")
cat("SPECIES-LEVEL RAW COUNT RESULTS SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================================\n")

for (species in target_species) {
  cat("\n---", species, "---\n")
  cat("Used adjustment:", species_models_raw[[species]]$used_adjustment, "\n")
  cat("Kept random effect:", species_models_raw[[species]]$kept_random, "\n")
}

sig_effects_raw <- species_pairs_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Species, p.value)

if (nrow(sig_effects_raw) > 0) {
  cat("\nSignificant contrasts:\n")
  print(sig_effects_raw %>% 
          dplyr::select(Species, Comparison, estimate, SE, z.ratio, p.value))
} else {
  cat("\nNo significant treatment effects at p < 0.05\n")
}

# Main treatment effects from ANOVA
cat("\n--- Main Treatment Effects (ANOVA) ---\n")
treatment_effects_raw <- do.call(rbind, species_anova_raw) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Term == "Treatment") %>%
  dplyr::select(Species, Chisq, Df, `Pr(>Chisq)`) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Significant = ifelse(`Pr(>Chisq)` < 0.05, "Yes", "No"))

print(treatment_effects_raw)

```
```{r}
##Pull model results for manuscript

# ==============================================================
# Species-level Enterococcus GLMM p-value extraction
# Correct reporting structure:
#   1. Global fixed effects: car::Anova(type = 3)
#   2. Per-growout treatment effects: emmeans pairwise contrasts
#   3. Per-growout position effects: refit within-growout models + car::Anova
# ==============================================================

library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

old_contr_species_pvals <- options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

# --------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: extract House random-effect variance
# --------------------------------------------------------------

.extract_house_rand_var <- function(model) {
  vc <- try(glmmTMB::VarCorr(model), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vc, "try-error")) return(NA_real_)

  vcdf <- try(as.data.frame(vc), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(vcdf, "try-error") || !nrow(vcdf)) return(NA_real_)

  row <- vcdf[
    vcdf$component == "cond" &
      vcdf$grp == "House",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (!nrow(row)) return(NA_real_)

  as.numeric(row$sdcor[1])^2
}

# ==============================================================
# 1. Global fixed-effect p-values
# ==============================================================

species_global_fixed_pvals <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(species_models_raw),
  function(species_i) {

    model_i <- species_models_raw[[species_i]]$model

    car::Anova(model_i, type = 3) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Fixed_Effect") %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        Chi_square = Chisq,
        df = Df,
        p_value = `Pr(>Chisq)`
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Species = species_i,
        Scope = "Global",
        Growout = NA_character_,
        Inference = "Type III Wald test",
        contrast = NA_character_,
        estimate = NA_real_,
        SE = NA_real_,
        test_statistic = Chi_square,
        test_statistic_type = "Chi-square",
        kept_random = species_models_raw[[species_i]]$kept_random,
        used_adjustment = species_models_raw[[species_i]]$used_adjustment
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Species,
        Scope,
        Growout,
        Fixed_Effect,
        Inference,
        contrast,
        estimate,
        SE,
        df,
        test_statistic_type,
        test_statistic,
        p_value,
        kept_random,
        used_adjustment
      )
  }
)

# ==============================================================
# 2. Per-growout treatment effects from emmeans
# ==============================================================

species_pergrowout_treatment_emmeans_pvals <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(species_models_raw),
  function(species_i) {

    out <- species_models_raw[[species_i]]$pergrowout_pairs %>%
      summary() %>%
      as.data.frame()

    stat_col <- dplyr::case_when(
      "t.ratio" %in% names(out) ~ "t.ratio",
      "z.ratio" %in% names(out) ~ "z.ratio",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )

    if (is.na(stat_col)) {
      out$test_statistic <- NA_real_
      out$test_statistic_type <- NA_character_
    } else {
      out$test_statistic <- out[[stat_col]]
      out$test_statistic_type <- stat_col
    }

    out %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Species = species_i,
        Scope = "Within growout",
        Fixed_Effect = "Treatment",
        Inference = "emmeans pairwise contrast",
        Chi_square = NA_real_,
        kept_random = species_models_raw[[species_i]]$kept_random,
        used_adjustment = species_models_raw[[species_i]]$used_adjustment
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        p_value = p.value
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Species,
        Scope,
        Growout,
        Fixed_Effect,
        Inference,
        contrast,
        estimate,
        SE,
        df,
        test_statistic_type,
        test_statistic,
        p_value,
        kept_random,
        used_adjustment
      )
  }
)

# ==============================================================
# 3. Per-growout position effects from within-growout models
# ==============================================================

species_pergrowout_position_pvals <- purrr::map_dfr(
  names(species_models_raw),
  function(species_i) {

    df_species <- entero_species_merged %>%
      dplyr::filter(Target..Name. == species_i) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Growout = as.factor(Growout),
        Treatment = as.factor(Treatment),
        House = as.factor(House),
        Position = as.factor(Position),
        copies_raw = copies_per_g_litter
      )

    purrr::map_dfr(
      levels(df_species$Growout),
      function(growout_i) {

        df_i <- df_species %>%
          dplyr::filter(Growout == growout_i) %>%
          base::droplevels()

        used_adjustment_i <- FALSE

        model_i <- tryCatch(
          {
            glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
              copies_raw ~ Treatment + Position + (1 | House),
              family = tweedie(link = "log"),
              data = df_i
            )
          },
          error = function(e) {
            used_adjustment_i <<- TRUE
            df_i$copies_adj <<- df_i$copies_raw + 0.1

            glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
              copies_adj ~ Treatment + Position + (1 | House),
              family = Gamma(link = "log"),
              data = df_i
            )
          }
        )

        rv_i <- .extract_house_rand_var(model_i)
        kept_random_i <- TRUE

        if (is.na(rv_i) || rv_i <= 1e-6) {
          kept_random_i <- FALSE

          if (used_adjustment_i) {
            model_i <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
              copies_adj ~ Treatment + Position,
              family = Gamma(link = "log"),
              data = df_i
            )
          } else {
            model_i <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
              copies_raw ~ Treatment + Position,
              family = tweedie(link = "log"),
              data = df_i
            )
          }
        }

        car::Anova(model_i, type = 3) %>%
          as.data.frame() %>%
          tibble::rownames_to_column("Fixed_Effect") %>%
          dplyr::filter(Fixed_Effect == "Position") %>%
          dplyr::rename(
            Chi_square = Chisq,
            df = Df,
            p_value = `Pr(>Chisq)`
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            Species = species_i,
            Scope = "Within growout",
            Growout = as.character(growout_i),
            Inference = "Type III Wald test",
            contrast = NA_character_,
            estimate = NA_real_,
            SE = NA_real_,
            test_statistic_type = "Chi-square",
            test_statistic = Chi_square,
            kept_random = kept_random_i,
            used_adjustment = used_adjustment_i
          ) %>%
          dplyr::select(
            Species,
            Scope,
            Growout,
            Fixed_Effect,
            Inference,
            contrast,
            estimate,
            SE,
            df,
            test_statistic_type,
            test_statistic,
            p_value,
            kept_random,
            used_adjustment
          )
      }
    )
  }
)

# ==============================================================
# 4. Combined reporting table
# ==============================================================

species_fixed_effect_pvals_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  species_global_fixed_pvals,
  species_pergrowout_treatment_emmeans_pvals,
  species_pergrowout_position_pvals
)

print(species_global_fixed_pvals)
print(species_pergrowout_treatment_emmeans_pvals)
print(species_pergrowout_position_pvals)
print(species_fixed_effect_pvals_all)

options(old_contr_species_pvals)

```


```{r}
##Combine and visualize all data + statistical output (genus and species)

# ==============================================================
# Combined Enterococcus visualization — Updated p-value sources
# ==============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ==============================================================
# Helper function to format p-values for plotmath
# ==============================================================

fmt_p_parse <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("italic(p)==NA")
  if (p < 1e-3) sprintf("italic(p)==%s", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 3))
  else sprintf("italic(p)==%.3f", p)
}

# ==============================================================
# 1. Combine genus and species data into long format
# ==============================================================

# Genus data
genus_data <- entero.merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "Enterococcus",
    copies_per_g_litter = copies_per_gram,
    log10_copies = log10(copies_per_gram),
    Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(Sample.NTC.Control)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Growout, Treatment, House, Position,
                copies_per_g_litter, log10_copies, Target)

# Species data
species_data <- entero_species_merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = paste("E.", tolower(Target..Name.)),
    log10_copies = log10(copies_per_g_litter),
    Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(Sample.NTC.Control)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Growout, Treatment, House, Position,
                copies_per_g_litter, log10_copies, Target)

# Combine and relabel
entero_combined_plot <- rbind(genus_data, species_data) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Growout = as.character(Growout),
    Treatment = factor(
      ifelse(Treatment == "IndigoLT", "Alternative", as.character(Treatment)),
      levels = c("Control", "Alternative")
    ),
    Target = factor(Target, levels = c("Enterococcus", "E. cecorum", "E. hirae"))
  )

cat("Combined plotting data:", nrow(entero_combined_plot), "rows\n")
cat("Targets:", levels(entero_combined_plot$Target), "\n")
cat("Treatments:", levels(entero_combined_plot$Treatment), "\n")

# ==============================================================
# 2. Extract p-values from updated statistical models
# ==============================================================

entero_pairs_df <- data.frame()

# Genus p-values (from raw count log-transformed model)
genus_pairs <- entero_genus_pairs_all_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(Comparison %in% c("Growout 1", "Growout 2")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "Enterococcus",
    Growout = gsub("Growout ", "", Comparison),
    P_Value = p.value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Target, Growout, P_Value)

# Species p-values (from raw count Tweedie models)
species_pairs <- species_pairs_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(Comparison %in% c("Growout 1", "Growout 2")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = paste("E.", tolower(Species)),
    Growout = gsub("Growout ", "", Comparison),
    P_Value = p.value
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Target, Growout, P_Value)

# Combine p-values
entero_pairs_df <- rbind(genus_pairs, species_pairs) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = factor(Target, levels = c("Enterococcus", "E. cecorum", "E. hirae")),
    Growout = as.character(Growout),
    P_Label = vapply(P_Value, fmt_p_parse, character(1))
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. Calculate y-positions for p-value annotations (log10 scale)
# ==============================================================

p_ypos_entero <- entero_combined_plot %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Growout) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(y_pos = max(log10_copies, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.02, 
                   .groups = "drop")

entero_pairs_annot <- dplyr::left_join(entero_pairs_df, p_ypos_entero, 
                                       by = c("Target", "Growout"))

# ==============================================================
# 4. Create combined plot with log10 scale
# ==============================================================

entero_combined_boxplot <- ggplot(entero_combined_plot, 
                                  aes(x = Growout, y = log10_copies)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.9,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    color = "white",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.25,
    alpha = 0.9,
    fill = "white",
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = 0.9
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = entero_pairs_annot,
    aes(x = Growout, y = y_pos, label = P_Label),
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Target, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#f8765c", "Alternative" = "#221150")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "black", "Alternative" = "black")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  
  labs(
    fill = "Treatment",
    x = "Growout",
    y = expression(Log[10]~"copies per gram litter")
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )

print(entero_combined_boxplot)

# ==============================================================
# 5. Summary of significant effects
# ==============================================================

cat("\n==============================================\n")
cat("SUMMARY OF SIGNIFICANT TREATMENT EFFECTS\n")
cat("==============================================\n")

sig_entero_effects <- entero_pairs_annot %>%
  dplyr::filter(P_Value < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Target, Growout)

if (nrow(sig_entero_effects) > 0) {
  print(sig_entero_effects %>% 
          dplyr::select(Target, Growout, P_Value))
} else {
  cat("No significant treatment effects at p < 0.05\n")
}

ggsave("entero.boxplot.combined.png", entero_combined_boxplot,
       width = 8, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = 900)
 
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Correlation between dPCR counts and 16S abundance
# Genus Enterococcus (from genus phyloseq) + Species (from species phyloseq)
# ==============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(phyloseq)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Extract genus-level Enterococcus abundance (from genus phyloseq)
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_corr <- phy_genus %>%
  subset_taxa(Genus == "Enterococcus") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Abundance, Growout, Treatment, House, Position) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "Enterococcus",
    Sample.NTC.Control = gsub("Sample_", "", Sample),
    CSS_abundance = Abundance
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Growout, Treatment, House, Position, 
                CSS_abundance, Target)

# ==============================================================
# 2. Extract species-level E. cecorum and E. hirae abundance (from species phyloseq)
# ==============================================================

# E. cecorum
cecorum_corr <- physeq_no_growout3_css %>%
  subset_taxa(Species == "Enterococcus cecorum") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Abundance, Growout, Treatment, House, Position) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "E. cecorum",
    Sample.NTC.Control = gsub("Sample_", "", Sample),
    CSS_abundance = Abundance
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Growout, Treatment, House, Position, 
                CSS_abundance, Target)

# E. hirae
hirae_corr <- physeq_no_growout3_css %>%
  subset_taxa(Species == "Enterococcus hirae") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Abundance, Growout, Treatment, House, Position) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "E. hirae",
    Sample.NTC.Control = gsub("Sample_", "", Sample),
    CSS_abundance = Abundance
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Growout, Treatment, House, Position, 
                CSS_abundance, Target)

# ==============================================================
# 3. Combine all microbiome data
# ==============================================================

microbiome_combined <- rbind(entero_genus_corr, cecorum_corr, hirae_corr) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = factor(Target, levels = c("Enterococcus", "E. cecorum", "E. hirae"))
  )

cat("Microbiome data rows:", nrow(microbiome_combined), "\n")
cat("Samples per target:\n")
print(table(microbiome_combined$Target))

# ==============================================================
# 4. Merge with dPCR data and create log10 copies
# ==============================================================

# Genus dPCR data
genus_dpcr <- entero.merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "Enterococcus",
    Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(Sample.NTC.Control),
    copies_per_g = copies_per_gram,
    log10_copies = log10(copies_per_gram)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Target, copies_per_g, log10_copies)

# Species dPCR data
species_dpcr <- entero_species_merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = paste("E.", tolower(Target..Name.)),
    Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(Sample.NTC.Control),
    copies_per_g = copies_per_g_litter,
    log10_copies = log10(copies_per_g_litter)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Target, copies_per_g, log10_copies)

# Combine dPCR data
dpcr_combined <- rbind(genus_dpcr, species_dpcr) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = factor(Target, levels = c("Enterococcus", "E. cecorum", "E. hirae"))
  )

# Merge microbiome and dPCR data
correlation_data <- microbiome_combined %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dpcr_combined, by = c("Sample.NTC.Control", "Target")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(CSS_abundance), !is.na(log10_copies), is.finite(log10_copies))

cat("Final correlation data:", nrow(correlation_data), "rows\n")
cat("Samples per target for correlation:\n")
print(table(correlation_data$Target))

# ==============================================================
# 5. Calculate correlations per target
# ==============================================================

correlation_stats <- correlation_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    rho = cor(CSS_abundance, log10_copies, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Calculate p-values manually
    t_stat = rho * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - rho^2)),
    p_value = 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = n - 2),
    # Format correlation label
    cor_label = paste0(
      "rho == ", round(rho, 2),
      "*','~~italic(p) == ", formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 2)
    )
  )

print(correlation_stats)

# ==============================================================
# 6. Create faceted correlation plot
# ==============================================================

# Define colors for each target
target_colors <- c(
  "Enterococcus" = "royalblue4",
  "E. cecorum" = "darkred", 
  "E. hirae" = "forestgreen"
)

# Add correlation labels to plotting data
correlation_plot_data <- correlation_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(correlation_stats %>% dplyr::select(Target, cor_label), 
                   by = "Target")

entero_correlation_plot <- ggplot(correlation_plot_data, 
                                  aes(x = CSS_abundance, y = log10_copies)) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Target),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", 
    se = TRUE, 
    color = "black", 
    alpha = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = correlation_stats,
    aes(label = cor_label),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 2,
    size = 3.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Target, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = target_colors) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  
  labs(
    x = "CSS-normalized 16S abundance",
    y = expression(Log[10]~"copies per gram litter (dPCR)"),
    fill = "Target"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "italic"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",  # Remove legend since colors match facet labels
    panel.spacing = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

print(entero_correlation_plot)

# ==============================================================
# 7. Save plot
# ==============================================================

ggsave("entero.correlation.combined.png", entero_correlation_plot,
       width = 8, height = 3, units = "in", dpi = 900)

# ==============================================================
# 8. Summary of correlation results
# ==============================================================

cat("\n==============================================\n")
cat("CORRELATION SUMMARY\n")
cat("==============================================\n")

correlation_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(Target, n, rho, p_value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Significant = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    rho = round(rho, 3),
    p_value = formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ) %>%
  print()

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# E. hirae correlation analysis — Non-zero 16S abundance only
# Restricted to samples where hirae is detected in both methods
# ==============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(phyloseq)

# ==============================================================
# Extract E. hirae abundance and filter to non-zero 16S
# ==============================================================

hirae_nonzero_corr <- physeq_no_growout3_css %>%
  subset_taxa(Species == "Enterococcus hirae") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Abundance, Growout, Treatment, House, Position) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Abundance > 0) %>%  # Remove zeros from 16S data
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample.NTC.Control = gsub("Sample_", "", Sample),
    CSS_abundance = Abundance
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Growout, Treatment, House, Position, CSS_abundance)

cat("E. hirae samples with non-zero 16S abundance:", nrow(hirae_nonzero_corr), "\n")

# ==============================================================
# Merge with E. hirae dPCR data
# ==============================================================

hirae_dpcr_subset <- entero_species_merged %>%
  dplyr::filter(Target..Name. == "Hirae") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(Sample.NTC.Control),
    copies_per_g = copies_per_g_litter,
    log10_copies = log10(copies_per_g_litter)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, copies_per_g, log10_copies)

hirae_correlation_nonzero <- hirae_nonzero_corr %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hirae_dpcr_subset, by = "Sample.NTC.Control") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(CSS_abundance), !is.na(log10_copies), is.finite(log10_copies))

cat("Final E. hirae non-zero correlation data:", nrow(hirae_correlation_nonzero), "rows\n")

# ==============================================================
# Calculate correlation for non-zero samples
# ==============================================================

hirae_cor_nonzero <- cor.test(
  hirae_correlation_nonzero$CSS_abundance,
  hirae_correlation_nonzero$log10_copies,
  method = "spearman"
)

hirae_rho_nonzero <- hirae_cor_nonzero$estimate
hirae_n_nonzero   <- sum(complete.cases(hirae_correlation_nonzero$CSS_abundance,
                                        hirae_correlation_nonzero$log10_copies))

# Recalculate p-value
hirae_t_stat_nonzero <- as.numeric(hirae_rho_nonzero) * sqrt((hirae_n_nonzero - 2) / (1 - hirae_rho_nonzero^2))
hirae_p_val_nonzero <- 2 * pt(-abs(hirae_t_stat_nonzero), df = hirae_n_nonzero - 2)

cat("\nE. hirae correlation (non-zero 16S only):\n")
cat("  rho =", round(hirae_rho_nonzero, 3), "\n")
cat("  n =", hirae_n_nonzero, "\n")
cat("  p-value =", formatC(hirae_p_val_nonzero, format = "e", digits = 2), "\n")

# Format label for plot
hirae_cor_label_nonzero <- paste0(
  "rho == ", round(hirae_rho_nonzero, 2),
  "*','~~italic(p) == ", formatC(hirae_p_val_nonzero, format = "e", digits = 2)
)

# ==============================================================
# Create E. hirae non-zero correlation plot
# ==============================================================

hirae_correlation_plot_nonzero <- ggplot(hirae_correlation_nonzero, 
                                         aes(x = CSS_abundance, y = log10_copies)) +
  
  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    fill = "forestgreen",
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm", 
    se = TRUE, 
    color = "black", 
    alpha = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    label = hirae_cor_label_nonzero,
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 2,
    size = 4
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  
  labs(
    x = "CSS-normalized E. hirae 16S abundance (>0 only)",
    y = expression(Log[10]~"copies per gram litter (dPCR)"),
    title = "E. hirae correlation — Non-zero 16S samples only"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(hirae_correlation_plot_nonzero)

# ==============================================================
# Save plot and compare with all-samples result
# ==============================================================

ggsave("hirae.correlation.nonzero.png", hirae_correlation_plot_nonzero,
       width = 5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 900)

# Compare with all-samples correlation (from previous analysis)
hirae_all_samples <- correlation_stats %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Target == "E. hirae")

cat("\n==============================================\n")
cat("E. HIRAE CORRELATION COMPARISON\n")
cat("==============================================\n")
cat("All samples:     rho =", round(hirae_all_samples$rho, 3), 
    "| n =", hirae_all_samples$n, 
    "| p =", formatC(hirae_all_samples$p_value, format = "e", digits = 2), "\n")
cat("Non-zero 16S:    rho =", round(hirae_rho_nonzero, 3), 
    "| n =", hirae_n_nonzero, 
    "| p =", formatC(hirae_p_val_nonzero, format = "e", digits = 2), "\n")
cat("Improvement:     Δrho =", round(hirae_rho_nonzero - hirae_all_samples$rho, 3), "\n")
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)

# ==============================================================
# Combined Enterococcus 16S + dPCR visualization
# CSS counts are plotted as log10(CSS + 1).
# Relative abundance is plotted as percent relative abundance.
# ==============================================================

.clean_treatment <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(as.character(x), "IndigoLT" = "Alternative")
}

# -------------------------------
# 1. Genus-level Enterococcus from phy_genus
# -------------------------------

entero_genus_css <- psmelt(phy_genus) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Genus == "Enterococcus") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(.clean_treatment(Treatment), levels = c("Control", "Alternative")),
    Growout   = factor(Growout),
    Target    = "italic('Enterococcus')",
    Measure   = "log[10]~CSS~counts~'(16S)'",
    value     = log10(Abundance + 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Growout, Treatment, Target, Measure, value)

phy_genus_rel <- transform_sample_counts(phy_genus, function(x) x / sum(x))

entero_genus_ra <- psmelt(phy_genus_rel) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Genus == "Enterococcus") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(.clean_treatment(Treatment), levels = c("Control", "Alternative")),
    Growout   = factor(Growout),
    Target    = "italic('Enterococcus')",
    Measure   = "'%'~relative~abundance~'(16S)'",
    value     = Abundance * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Growout, Treatment, Target, Measure, value)

# -------------------------------
# 2. Species-level E. cecorum and E. hirae from physeq_no_growout3_css
# -------------------------------

species_css_long <- psmelt(physeq_no_growout3_css) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Genus == "Enterococcus") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species_clean = tolower(gsub("^Enterococcus\\s+", "", Species)),
    Target = dplyr::case_when(
      Species_clean %in% c("cecorum", "e. cecorum", "enterococcus cecorum") ~ "italic('E. cecorum')",
      Species_clean %in% c("hirae", "e. hirae", "enterococcus hirae")       ~ "italic('E. hirae')",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Target)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(.clean_treatment(Treatment), levels = c("Control", "Alternative")),
    Growout   = factor(Growout),
    Measure   = "log[10]~CSS~counts~'(16S)'",
    value     = log10(Abundance + 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Growout, Treatment, Target, Measure, value)

phy_species_rel <- transform_sample_counts(physeq_no_growout3_css, function(x) x / sum(x))

species_ra_long <- psmelt(phy_species_rel) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Genus == "Enterococcus") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species_clean = tolower(gsub("^Enterococcus\\s+", "", Species)),
    Target = dplyr::case_when(
      Species_clean %in% c("cecorum", "e. cecorum", "enterococcus cecorum") ~ "italic('E. cecorum')",
      Species_clean %in% c("hirae", "e. hirae", "enterococcus hirae")       ~ "italic('E. hirae')",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Target)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(.clean_treatment(Treatment), levels = c("Control", "Alternative")),
    Growout   = factor(Growout),
    Measure   = "'%'~relative~abundance~'(16S)'",
    value     = Abundance * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Growout, Treatment, Target, Measure, value)

# -------------------------------
# 3. dPCR data from existing entero_combined_plot
# -------------------------------

dpcr_long <- entero_combined_plot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(.clean_treatment(Treatment), levels = c("Control", "Alternative")),
    Growout   = factor(Growout),
    Target = dplyr::case_when(
      Target %in% c("Enterococcus", "Genus", "Total Enterococcus") ~ "italic('Enterococcus')",
      Target %in% c("Cecorum", "E. cecorum", "Enterococcus cecorum") ~ "italic('E. cecorum')",
      Target %in% c("Hirae", "E. hirae", "Enterococcus hirae") ~ "italic('E. hirae')",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Target)
    ),
    Measure = "log[10]~counts~'(dPCR)'",
    value   = log10_copies
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Growout, Treatment, Target, Measure, value)

# -------------------------------
# 4. Combine all plotting data
# -------------------------------

entero_all_plot <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  entero_genus_css,
  species_css_long,
  entero_genus_ra,
  species_ra_long,
  dpcr_long
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = factor(
      Target,
      levels = c("italic('Enterococcus')", "italic('E. cecorum')", "italic('E. hirae')")
    ),
    Measure = factor(
      Measure,
      levels = c(
        "log[10]~CSS~counts~'(16S)'",
        "'%'~relative~abundance~'(16S)'",
        "log[10]~counts~'(dPCR)'"
      )
    )
  )

# -------------------------------
# 5. Prepare dPCR-only stats annotations
# -------------------------------

entero_pairs_annot_combined <- entero_pairs_annot %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Growout = factor(Growout),
    Target = dplyr::case_when(
      Target %in% c("Enterococcus", "Genus", "Total Enterococcus") ~ "italic('Enterococcus')",
      Target %in% c("Cecorum", "E. cecorum", "Enterococcus cecorum") ~ "italic('E. cecorum')",
      Target %in% c("Hirae", "E. hirae", "Enterococcus hirae") ~ "italic('E. hirae')",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Target)
    ),
    Target = factor(
      Target,
      levels = c("italic('Enterococcus')", "italic('E. cecorum')", "italic('E. hirae')")
    ),
    Measure = factor(
      "log[10]~counts~'(dPCR)'",
      levels = c(
        "log[10]~CSS~counts~'(16S)'",
        "'%'~relative~abundance~'(16S)'",
        "log[10]~counts~'(dPCR)'"
      )
    )
  )

# -------------------------------
# 6. Combined plot
# ==============================================================

entero_16s_dpcr_boxplot <- ggplot(
  entero_all_plot,
  aes(x = Growout, y = value)
) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.9,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    aes(fill = Treatment),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    color = "white",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.25,
    alpha = 0.9,
    fill = "white",
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = 0.9
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = entero_pairs_annot_combined,
    aes(x = Growout, y = y_pos, label = P_Label),
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 0
  ) +
  
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(Measure),
    cols = vars(Target),
    scales = "free",
    independent = "y",
    labeller = labeller(
      Measure = label_parsed,
      Target = label_parsed
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control" = "#f8765c", "Alternative" = "#221150")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "black", "Alternative" = "black")) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  
  labs(
    fill = "Treatment",
    x = "Growout",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(entero_16s_dpcr_boxplot)

ggsave(
  "entero_16s_dpcr_boxplot.png",
  entero_16s_dpcr_boxplot,
  width = 6,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 900
)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Correlation between dPCR counts and log10 CSS 16S abundance
# Genus Enterococcus + Species E. cecorum / E. hirae
# Does NOT overwrite existing objects
# Zero values are retained as 0 after log10 transformation
# ==============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(phyloseq)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Extract genus-level Enterococcus abundance
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_corr_logcss <- phy_genus %>%
  subset_taxa(Genus == "Enterococcus") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Abundance, Growout, Treatment, House, Position) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "Enterococcus",
    Sample.NTC.Control = gsub("Sample_", "", Sample),
    CSS_abundance = Abundance,
    log10_CSS_abundance = dplyr::case_when(
      CSS_abundance == 0 ~ 0,
      CSS_abundance > 0  ~ log10(CSS_abundance),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample.NTC.Control, Growout, Treatment, House, Position,
    CSS_abundance, log10_CSS_abundance, Target
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Extract species-level E. cecorum and E. hirae abundance
# ==============================================================

cecorum_corr_logcss <- physeq_no_growout3_css %>%
  subset_taxa(Species == "Enterococcus cecorum") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Abundance, Growout, Treatment, House, Position) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "E. cecorum",
    Sample.NTC.Control = gsub("Sample_", "", Sample),
    CSS_abundance = Abundance,
    log10_CSS_abundance = dplyr::case_when(
      CSS_abundance == 0 ~ 0,
      CSS_abundance > 0  ~ log10(CSS_abundance),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample.NTC.Control, Growout, Treatment, House, Position,
    CSS_abundance, log10_CSS_abundance, Target
  )

hirae_corr_logcss <- physeq_no_growout3_css %>%
  subset_taxa(Species == "Enterococcus hirae") %>%
  psmelt() %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample, Abundance, Growout, Treatment, House, Position) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "E. hirae",
    Sample.NTC.Control = gsub("Sample_", "", Sample),
    CSS_abundance = Abundance,
    log10_CSS_abundance = dplyr::case_when(
      CSS_abundance == 0 ~ 0,
      CSS_abundance > 0  ~ log10(CSS_abundance),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample.NTC.Control, Growout, Treatment, House, Position,
    CSS_abundance, log10_CSS_abundance, Target
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. Combine all microbiome data
# ==============================================================

microbiome_combined_logcss <- rbind(
  entero_genus_corr_logcss,
  cecorum_corr_logcss,
  hirae_corr_logcss
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = factor(Target, levels = c("Enterococcus", "E. cecorum", "E. hirae"))
  )

cat("Microbiome data rows:", nrow(microbiome_combined_logcss), "\n")
cat("Samples per target:\n")
print(table(microbiome_combined_logcss$Target))

# ==============================================================
# 4. Merge with dPCR data and create log10 copies
# ==============================================================

genus_dpcr_logcss <- entero.merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "Enterococcus",
    Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(Sample.NTC.Control),
    copies_per_g = copies_per_gram,
    log10_copies = dplyr::case_when(
      copies_per_g == 0 ~ 0,
      copies_per_g > 0  ~ log10(copies_per_g),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Target, copies_per_g, log10_copies)

species_dpcr_logcss <- entero_species_merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = paste("E.", tolower(Target..Name.)),
    Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(Sample.NTC.Control),
    copies_per_g = copies_per_g_litter,
    log10_copies = dplyr::case_when(
      copies_per_g == 0 ~ 0,
      copies_per_g > 0  ~ log10(copies_per_g),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Sample.NTC.Control, Target, copies_per_g, log10_copies)

dpcr_combined_logcss <- rbind(
  genus_dpcr_logcss,
  species_dpcr_logcss
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = factor(Target, levels = c("Enterococcus", "E. cecorum", "E. hirae"))
  )

correlation_data_logcss <- microbiome_combined_logcss %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dpcr_combined_logcss, by = c("Sample.NTC.Control", "Target")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(log10_CSS_abundance),
    !is.na(log10_copies),
    is.finite(log10_CSS_abundance),
    is.finite(log10_copies)
  )

cat("Final correlation data:", nrow(correlation_data_logcss), "rows\n")
cat("Samples per target for correlation:\n")
print(table(correlation_data_logcss$Target))

# ==============================================================
# 5. Calculate correlations per target
# ==============================================================

correlation_stats_logcss <- correlation_data_logcss %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    rho = cor(
      log10_CSS_abundance,
      log10_copies,
      method = "spearman",
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    t_stat = rho * sqrt((n - 2) / (1 - rho^2)),
    p_value = 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat), df = n - 2),
    cor_label = paste0(
      "rho == ", round(rho, 2),
      "*','~~italic(p) == ", formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 2)
    )
  )

print(correlation_stats_logcss)

# ==============================================================
# 6. Create faceted correlation plot
# ==============================================================

target_colors_logcss <- c(
  "Enterococcus" = "royalblue4",
  "E. cecorum" = "darkred",
  "E. hirae" = "forestgreen"
)

correlation_plot_data_logcss <- correlation_data_logcss %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    correlation_stats_logcss %>%
      dplyr::select(Target, cor_label),
    by = "Target"
  )

entero_correlation_plot_logcss <- ggplot(
  correlation_plot_data_logcss,
  aes(x = log10_CSS_abundance, y = log10_copies)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Target),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = correlation_stats_logcss,
    aes(label = cor_label),
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 2,
    size = 4,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Target, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = target_colors_logcss) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    x = expression(Log[10]~"CSS counts (16S)"),
    y = expression(Log[10]~"counts (dPCR)"),
    fill = "Target"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 13, face = "italic"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(entero_correlation_plot_logcss)

# ==============================================================
# 7. Save plot
# ==============================================================

ggsave(
  "entero.correlation.combined.log10CSS.png",
  entero_correlation_plot_logcss,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 3.2,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 900
)

# ==============================================================
# 8. Summary of correlation results
# ==============================================================

cat("\n==============================================\n")
cat("CORRELATION SUMMARY: log10 CSS abundance, zeros retained as 0\n")
cat("==============================================\n")

correlation_stats_logcss %>%
  dplyr::select(Target, n, rho, p_value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Significant = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
    rho = round(rho, 3),
    p_value = formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ) %>%
  print()

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# Correlation between dPCR counts and log10 CSS 16S abundance
```
```{r}
# Rows: zeros retained vs zeros removed
# Columns: Target
# Independent scales using ggh4x
# ==============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Create zero-retained and zero-removed datasets
# ==============================================================

correlation_data_with_zeros_plot <- correlation_data_logcss %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Zero_Status = "Zeros retained"
  )

correlation_data_no_zeros_plot <- correlation_data_logcss %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    CSS_abundance > 0,
    copies_per_g > 0,
    log10_CSS_abundance > 0,
    log10_copies > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Zero_Status = "Zeros removed"
  )

correlation_data_combined_zero_status <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  correlation_data_with_zeros_plot,
  correlation_data_no_zeros_plot
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = factor(Target, levels = c("Enterococcus", "E. cecorum", "E. hirae")),
    Zero_Status = factor(
      Zero_Status,
      levels = c("Zeros retained", "Zeros removed")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Correlation stats
# ==============================================================

correlation_stats_combined_zero_status <- correlation_data_combined_zero_status %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Zero_Status, Target) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    rho = cor(
      log10_CSS_abundance,
      log10_copies,
      method = "spearman",
      use = "complete.obs"
    ),
    p_value = cor.test(
      log10_CSS_abundance,
      log10_copies,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cor_label = paste0(
      "rho == ", round(rho, 2),
      "*','~~italic(p) == '", formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 2), "'"
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. Plot
# ==============================================================

entero_correlation_plot_zero_comparison <- ggplot(
  correlation_data_combined_zero_status,
  aes(x = log10_CSS_abundance, y = log10_copies)
) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Target),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = correlation_stats_combined_zero_status,
    aes(label = cor_label),
    x = Inf,
    y = -Inf,
    parse = TRUE,
    hjust = 1.08,
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(Zero_Status),
    cols = vars(Target),
    scales = "free",
    independent = "all"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = target_colors_logcss) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.22, 0.15))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    x = expression(Log[10]~"CSS counts (16S)"),
    y = expression(Log[10]~"counts (dPCR)"),
    fill = "Target"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(entero_correlation_plot_zero_comparison)

ggsave(
  "entero.correlation.combined.log10CSS.zero_comparison.png",
  entero_correlation_plot_zero_comparison,
  width = 6,
  height = 3,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 900
)
```
